learn.hook: Spin like a top! Every time you turn, you make an angle.
points: An angle tells us how much something has turned.
We measure turns in degrees (°). A full turn is 360°.
A half turn is 180°. A quarter turn is 90°. A three-quarter turn is 270°.
Clockwise means turning the way clock hands move. Anticlockwise is the opposite way.

example.q: Riya faces North and makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does she face? How many degrees did she turn?
steps: Clockwise from North: North → East
A quarter turn = 360° ÷ 4 = 90°

learn.reallife: A bowler running up, a fan blade, a door opening and a steering wheel all make turns.

items.text: Two quarter turns make a ___ turn.
Facing North, a quarter turn clockwise makes you face ___.

quiz.q: How many degrees are there in a full turn?
quiz.explain: A full turn brings you back to where you started. It is 360°.
steps: A full turn brings you all the way round, back to the start.
We measure turns in degrees; a full turn is 360°.
So a full turn = 360°.
Answer: 360°
quiz.mistake: Thinks a full turn is 100° or confuses it with a half turn

quiz.q: A half turn is how many degrees?
quiz.explain: Half of a full turn: 360° ÷ 2 = 180°.
steps: Full turn = 360°
Answer: 180°
quiz.mistake: Confuses a half turn with a quarter turn

quiz.q: Arjun faces North and makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does he face now?
quiz.explain: Clockwise from North the next direction is East. A quarter turn takes you there.
steps: Clockwise order: North → East → South → West.
A quarter turn moves one step in that order.
From North, one step clockwise is East.
Answer: East
quiz.mistake: Turns anticlockwise instead of clockwise

quiz.q: How many quarter turns make one full turn?
quiz.explain: Each quarter turn is 90°. 360° ÷ 90° = 4.
steps: Full turn 360°
Quarter turn 90°
Answer: 4
quiz.mistake: Thinks two quarters make a whole

quiz.q: The minute hand moves from 12 to 3. How many degrees does it turn?
quiz.explain: 12 to 3 is a quarter of the clock: 3 gaps × 30° = 90°.
steps: Each gap on the clock is 30°
Answer: 90°
quiz.mistake: Uses the clock number 3 as the angle

quiz.q: Kabir makes a three-quarter turn. How many degrees is that?
quiz.explain: Three quarter turns: 3 × 90° = 270°.
steps: 1 quarter turn = 90°
Answer: 270°
quiz.mistake: Counts only one or two quarter turns

quiz.q: Meena faces East and makes a half turn. Which way does she face now?
quiz.explain: A half turn makes you face the opposite way. Opposite of East is West.
steps: A half turn = 2 quarter turns = 180°.
It makes you face the opposite way.
The opposite of East is West.
Answer: West
quiz.mistake: Makes only a quarter turn

quiz.q: The minute hand goes from 12 to 6. What kind of turn is this?
quiz.explain: 12 to 6 is halfway round the clock. That is a half turn, 180°.
steps: 12 to 6 is 6 of the 12 gaps on the clock.
6 out of 12 is half the way round.
So it is a half turn (180°).
Answer: A half turn
quiz.mistake: Thinks 6 numbers means a quarter turn

teach.ask: Gappu spins and gets dizzy: 'What is an angle?'
teach.praise: Wheee! An angle is how much I turn. A full turn is 360 degrees!
teach.nudge: But what does an angle measure? How do we count how big the turn is?

revise.summary: An angle tells how much something has turned. Turns are measured in degrees: full turn 360°, half turn 180°, quarter turn 90°, three-quarter turn 270°.
focus: Know the degrees in full, half, quarter and three-quarter turns
Find the direction faced after a turn
Tell clockwise from anticlockwise
remember: Full turn = 360°, half turn = 180°, quarter turn = 90°, three-quarter turn = 270°
Clockwise: the way clock hands move. Anticlockwise: the opposite way.
4 quarter turns = 1 full turn
traps: Don't confuse a half turn (180°) with a quarter turn (90°).
Don't use the clock number as the angle: 12 to 3 is 90°, not 3°.

learn.hook: Open a door, twist a tap, turn a key — you make turns all day long without noticing!
points: Many things turn: a tap, a key in a lock, a door, a steering wheel, a bottle cap, a fan.
A quarter turn is like a square corner. Some things open less than a quarter turn, some exactly a quarter, some more.
A clothes clip opens less than a quarter turn. A room door opens about a quarter turn. A file cover can open to a half turn.
A ceiling fan blade, a giant wheel and a bottle cap can make full turns again and again.

example.q: Is the opening of a pair of scissors more or less than a quarter turn?
steps: Open the scissors as wide as they go
Compare the gap with a square corner
The blades open less than a square corner

learn.reallife: Drivers turn the steering wheel to go round a corner, and we turn a key to open the lock at home.

games.title: Turns true or false
items: A bottle cap can make full turns.
You twist it round and round.
A clothes clip opens more than a half turn.
It opens only a little, less than a quarter turn.
A ceiling fan blade makes many full turns.
A tap handle turns when we open it.
A door opened until it makes a square corner with its closed position has made a quarter turn.
A square corner is a quarter turn.

quiz.q: Which of these makes full turns again and again?
quiz.explain: Fan blades go round and round, making full turns.
steps: A clip, tongs and a stapler only open and close.
A ceiling fan blade goes round and round.
So the fan blade makes full turns again and again.
Answer: A ceiling fan blade
quiz.mistake: Confuses opening and closing with turning round

quiz.q: A clothes clip opens as wide as it can. Is the opening more or less than a quarter turn?
quiz.explain: A clip opens only a little — much less than a square corner.
steps: Compare the clip's opening with a square corner (quarter turn).
A clip opens only a little, much less than a square corner.
So it is less than a quarter turn.
Answer: Less than a quarter turn
quiz.mistake: Thinks every opening is a quarter turn

quiz.q: Which object can open to about a half turn, making a straight line?
quiz.explain: A notebook opened flat makes a straight line, a half turn.
steps: A half turn makes a straight line.
Scissors, tongs and clips open only a little.
A notebook cover laid flat makes a straight line: about a half turn.
Answer: A notebook cover laid flat
quiz.mistake: Mixes up half and quarter turns

quiz.q: Which is NOT an example of turning?
options: Sliding a book across a table
quiz.explain: Sliding moves something along without turning it.
steps: Turning a key, a tap or a cycle handle makes them rotate.
Sliding a book moves it along without turning it.
So sliding a book is NOT turning.
Answer: Sliding a book across a table
quiz.mistake: Thinks every movement is a turn

quiz.q: A cupboard door is opened so it makes a square corner with the cupboard. What turn is that?
quiz.explain: A square corner is a quarter turn.
steps: A square corner is a quarter turn.
The door makes a square corner with the cupboard.
So it has made a quarter turn.
Answer: A quarter turn
quiz.mistake: Thinks a door opening is a half turn

quiz.q: Raghav twists a bottle cap 3 full turns. Where does the mark on the cap point now?
quiz.explain: After each full turn the cap is back to where it started, so after 3 full turns it is the same.
steps: After one full turn, the cap is back where it started.
Each of the 3 full turns ends back at the start.
So the mark points the same way it started.
Answer: The same way it started
quiz.mistake: Thinks full turns change the facing direction

quiz.q: Which opens to more than a quarter turn?
quiz.explain: A laptop lid can open well past a square corner.
steps: More than a quarter turn means wider than a square corner.
A clip, a curler and tongs open less than a square corner.
A laptop lid opened wide goes past a square corner.
Answer: A laptop lid opened wide
quiz.mistake: Does not compare with a square corner

quiz.q: Two half turns of a giant wheel make how much turn?
quiz.explain: Half + half = one full turn.
steps: A half turn is 1/2 of a full turn.
So two half turns make a full turn.
Answer: A full turn
quiz.mistake: Thinks two halves make a half

teach.ask: Gappu wants examples of turning at home and wants to know which open more than a quarter turn. Can you tell me?
teach.praise: Now I see turns everywhere — doors, taps and fans!
teach.nudge: Can you name things at home that turn, and compare them with a square corner?

revise.summary: Many things around us turn: taps, keys, doors, fans and bottle caps. We compare an opening with a square corner (quarter turn) to say if it is less, equal or more.
focus: Spot turning in everyday objects
Compare an opening with a quarter turn
Know which objects make full turns again and again
remember: A quarter turn is like a square corner
A clip opens less than a quarter turn; a door about a quarter; a flat file cover a half
After any number of full turns, an object faces where it started
traps: Don't think every opening is a quarter turn.

learn.hook: The corner of your notebook is a secret angle checker. Let's use it!
points: A right angle is a quarter turn, 90°. It looks like a square corner.
An acute angle is less than a right angle (less than 90°). It looks sharp.
An obtuse angle is more than 90° but less than 180°. It looks wide open.
A straight angle is 180°. Its two arms make a straight line.
Test an angle with the corner of a page: does it fit inside, match, or stick out?

steps: 125° is more than 90°
125° is less than 180°
So it is between 90° and 180°

learn.reallife: Look for angles in a slice of pizza (acute), a door corner (right) and a reclining chair (obtuse).

games.title: True or false?
items: A right angle is a quarter turn.
A quarter turn is 90°, which is a right angle.
An acute angle is bigger than a right angle.
Its arms make a straight line, a half turn.
The corner of a square is an obtuse angle.
Each corner of a square is a right angle.

quiz.q: What kind of angle is 45°?
quiz.explain: 45° is less than 90°, so it is acute.
steps: Acute: less than 90°. Right: 90°. Obtuse: 90° to 180°.
45° is less than 90°.
So 45° is acute.
Answer: Acute
quiz.mistake: Thinks any angle that is not tiny is right or obtuse

quiz.q: Which angle is obtuse?
quiz.explain: 150° is more than 90° and less than 180°.
steps: Obtuse means more than 90° and less than 180°.
60° is acute, 90° is right, 180° is straight.
150° is between 90° and 180°, so 150° is obtuse.
Answer: 150°
quiz.mistake: Thinks 180° is obtuse, but it is a straight angle

quiz.q: The corner of a notebook page makes which kind of angle?
quiz.explain: A page corner is a square corner, 90°. That is a right angle.
steps: A page corner is a square corner.
A square corner is a quarter turn = 90°.
90° is a right angle.
Answer: Right
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the names right and acute

quiz.q: What kind of angle is 179°?
quiz.explain: 179° is more than 90° and just less than 180°, so it is obtuse.
steps: 179° is more than 90°.
179° is less than 180°, so it is not straight.
Between 90° and 180° → obtuse.
Answer: Obtuse
quiz.mistake: Thinks an angle very close to 180° is straight

quiz.q: At 3 o'clock, what kind of angle do the clock hands make?
quiz.explain: From 12 to 3 is 3 × 30° = 90°, a right angle.
steps: At 3 o'clock, the hands point to 12 and 3: 3 gaps.
Each gap is 30°, so 3 × 30° = 90°.
90° is a right angle.
Answer: Right
quiz.mistake: Forgets that 3 gaps on a clock make a quarter turn

quiz.q: At 1 o'clock, what kind of angle do the clock hands make?
quiz.explain: From 12 to 1 is 30°, which is less than 90°. It is acute.
steps: At 1 o'clock, the hands point to 12 and 1: 1 gap.
30° is less than 90°, so it is acute.
Answer: Acute
quiz.mistake: Thinks every clock angle is a right angle

quiz.q: At 5 o'clock, the smaller angle between the hands is 150°. What kind of angle is it?
quiz.explain: 150° is between 90° and 180°, so it is obtuse.
steps: The angle is 150°.
150° is more than 90° and less than 180°.
So it is obtuse.
Answer: Obtuse
quiz.mistake: Mixes up acute and obtuse

quiz.q: Harpreet says every angle bigger than 90° is obtuse. Is she right?
options: No, an obtuse angle must also be less than 180°
No, obtuse angles are less than 90°
quiz.explain: Obtuse angles are between 90° and 180°. 180° is a straight angle, so 'bigger than 90°' is not enough.
steps: Obtuse angles are more than 90° AND less than 180°.
180° is straight, and angles like 200° are not obtuse.
So No, an obtuse angle must also be less than 180°.
Answer: No, an obtuse angle must also be less than 180°
quiz.mistake: Forgets the upper limit of 180° for obtuse angles

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'How do I tell acute, right and obtuse angles apart?'
teach.praise: Super! Smaller than 90 is acute, exactly 90 is right, bigger is obtuse!
teach.nudge: What number do we compare with? What makes an angle acute and what makes it obtuse?

revise.summary: A right angle is 90°, an acute angle is less than 90°, an obtuse angle is between 90° and 180°, and a straight angle is 180°.
focus: Name an angle from its size in degrees
Test angles with a page corner
Name the angle made by clock hands
remember: Right = 90°; acute < 90°; obtuse: more than 90° and less than 180°; straight = 180°
Each clock gap is 30°
traps: Bigger than 90° alone is not enough for obtuse.

topics.title: Finding angles in pictures and bodies

learn.hook: Fold a paper fan and open it slowly. Watch it go from sharp to wide — acute to obtuse!
points: A paper fan opened a little makes an acute angle. Opened wide (but not flat) it makes an obtuse angle.
In a house drawing, the walls meet the floor at right angles. The roof top can be acute, and the roof joins the wall at an obtuse angle.
Our legs and arms make angles: legs together make almost no turn, legs in a full split make a straight angle.
To check an angle, compare it with a square corner (right angle).
A five-sided house shape can have 2 right angles, 2 obtuse angles and 1 acute angle.

example.q: A gymnast stretches her legs into a full side split, making a straight line. What angle is between her legs?
steps: Both legs are in one straight line
A straight line is a half turn

learn.reallife: Look at a ladder against a wall, a roof, or the hands of a dancer. Angles are all around us!

games.title: Picture angles
items: A square window has 4 right angles.
Each corner is a square corner.
A paper fan opened just a little shows an obtuse angle.
A gymnast's legs in a full split make a straight angle.
The legs form a straight line.
A five-sided shape can have 2 right angles.
Every roof top is a right angle.
Roof tops can be acute, right or obtuse.

quiz.q: Neha opens her paper fan just a little. What angle does it make?
quiz.explain: A small opening is less than a quarter turn, which is acute.
steps: A small opening is less than a square corner.
Less than a quarter turn is acute.
So the fan makes an acute angle.
Answer: Acute
quiz.mistake: Thinks any open fan is obtuse

quiz.q: She opens the fan wider, more than a square corner but not flat. What angle now?
quiz.explain: Between a quarter turn and a half turn is obtuse.
steps: Wider than a square corner: more than 90°.
Not flat: less than 180°.
Between 90° and 180° is obtuse.
Answer: Obtuse
quiz.mistake: Mixes up acute and obtuse

quiz.q: In a house drawing, what angle is made where the wall meets the floor?
quiz.explain: Walls stand straight up from the floor, making a square corner.
steps: Walls stand straight up from the floor.
They make a square corner with the floor.
A square corner is a right angle.
Answer: Right angle
quiz.mistake: Does not compare with a square corner

quiz.q: A drawn roof has a pointed top that is sharper than a square corner. What angle is the top?
quiz.explain: Sharper than a square corner means less than a right angle, so acute.
steps: Sharper than a square corner means less than 90°.
Less than 90° is acute.
So the roof top is acute.
Answer: Acute
quiz.mistake: Thinks pointed means obtuse

quiz.q: A gymnast lifts one leg straight up while standing on the other. The legs look like an L. What angle is that?
quiz.explain: An L shape is a square corner, a right angle.
steps: An L shape has a square corner.
A square corner is 90°.
So the legs make a right angle.
Answer: Right angle
quiz.mistake: Mixes up right and straight angles

quiz.q: Which body position shows a straight angle?
options: Arms stretched out sideways in one line
Arm bent at the elbow like an L
quiz.explain: Arms stretched out in one line make a straight line, a half turn.
steps: A straight angle is a straight line (half turn).
Bent knees, namaste and an L-shaped elbow are not straight lines.
Arms stretched out sideways in one line make a straight angle.
Answer: Arms stretched out sideways in one line
quiz.mistake: Thinks a bent arm is a straight angle

quiz.q: A five-sided house shape has 2 right angles at the bottom and an acute angle at the top. What are the other 2 angles?
quiz.explain: The roof slopes out from the wall, making angles wider than a square corner: obtuse.
steps: Where the roof meets each wall, it slopes outward.
That angle is wider than a square corner but not flat.
So the other 2 angles are obtuse.
Answer: Obtuse
quiz.mistake: Thinks all corners of a house are right angles

quiz.q: Which shape can have 2 right, 2 obtuse and 1 acute angle?
quiz.explain: A pentagon like a house with a pointed roof has this mix. A square and rectangle have only right angles; a triangle has 3 angles.
steps: 2 right + 2 obtuse + 1 acute = 5 angles, so the shape needs 5 corners.
A square and rectangle have 4 right angles; a triangle has 3 angles.
A five-sided house shape has this mix.
Answer: A five-sided house shape
quiz.mistake: Does not count the number of corners

teach.ask: Gappu made a paper fan. How do the angles change as I open it more and more?
teach.praise: First acute, then a right angle, then obtuse. My fan is a maths fan!
teach.nudge: What angle do I get with a small opening, and what with a wide one?

revise.summary: We find acute, right, obtuse and straight angles in fans, house drawings and our own bodies by comparing each with a square corner.
focus: Name angles in a paper fan, a house drawing and body poses
Know the angle mix in a five-sided house shape
remember: Walls meet the floor at right angles
A full side split or arms stretched in a line make a straight angle
A five-sided house shape: 2 right, 2 obtuse, 1 acute angle
traps: Pointed does not mean obtuse; a sharp roof top is acute.
Don't think every corner of a house shape is a right angle.

learn.hook: An arrow ends up pointing up after a quarter turn. Where did it start? Think backwards like a detective!
points: We can name a turn as a fraction of a full turn: 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 3/8, 5/8 …
Fold a paper circle in half, then half again, then half again: you get 8 equal parts. Each is 1/8 of a turn.
2/8 of a turn = 1/4 turn. 4/8 = 1/2 turn. 3/8 is between a quarter and a half turn.
To find where an arrow started, turn it back the same amount the other way.
In degrees: 1/8 turn = 45°, 1/4 turn = 90°, 3/8 turn = 135°, 1/2 turn = 180°.

example.q: An arrow turned 1/4 turn clockwise and now points up (to 12 on a clock). Where did it start?
steps: Turn it back 1/4 turn anticlockwise
From 12, a quarter turn anticlockwise goes to 9

learn.reallife: A pizza cut into 8 equal slices shows eighths of a turn around its centre.

quiz.q: An arrow made a 1/2 turn and now points down. Which way did it start?
quiz.explain: A half turn makes it face the opposite way, so it started pointing up.
steps: A half turn makes the arrow point the opposite way.
To go back, turn a half turn again.
Opposite of down is up, so it started pointing up.
Answer: Up
quiz.mistake: Thinks a half turn leaves the arrow the same

quiz.q: An arrow made a 1/4 turn clockwise and now points right (to 3). Where did it start?
quiz.explain: Turn back a quarter turn anticlockwise from 3 to reach 12.
steps: To undo a 1/4 turn clockwise, turn 1/4 anticlockwise.
From 3, a quarter turn anticlockwise goes back to 12.
So it started pointing up (to 12).
Answer: Up (to 12)
quiz.mistake: Turns back in the same direction

quiz.q: An arrow turned 1/8 turn clockwise and now points to 3 o'clock. Where did it start?
quiz.explain: 1/8 turn is half of a quarter turn. Going back from 3 by half a quarter lands halfway between 12 and 3.
steps: A 1/8 turn is half of a quarter turn.
Undo it: turn 1/8 anticlockwise from 3.
Half of the way from 3 back to 12 → halfway between 12 and 3.
Answer: Halfway between 12 and 3
quiz.mistake: Uses a quarter turn instead of an eighth

quiz.q: How many 1/8 turns make a quarter turn?
quiz.explain: 1/4 = 2/8, so two eighth turns.
steps: Write a quarter turn in eighths: 1/4 = 2/8.
2/8 is two 1/8 turns.
So 2 eighth turns make a quarter turn.
Answer: 2
quiz.mistake: Thinks 4 eighths make a quarter

quiz.q: 3/8 of a turn is between which two turns?
options: A quarter turn and a half turn
No turn and a quarter turn
A half turn and a full turn
A full turn and two full turns
quiz.explain: 1/4 = 2/8 and 1/2 = 4/8. 3/8 is between them.
steps: Change to eighths: 1/4 = 2/8 and 1/2 = 4/8.
3/8 is more than 2/8 and less than 4/8.
So 3/8 lies between a quarter turn and a half turn.
Answer: A quarter turn and a half turn
quiz.mistake: Does not change quarters and halves into eighths

quiz.q: Which fraction of a turn is 4/8 the same as?
quiz.explain: 4/8 is half of 8 eighths, so it is a half turn.
steps: A full turn has 8 eighths.
4 is half of 8, so 4/8 = 1/2.
4/8 of a turn is the same as 1/2 turn.
Answer: 1/2
quiz.mistake: Reads 4/8 as 4 turns

quiz.q: 5/8 of a full turn is how many degrees?
steps: Answer: 225°
quiz.mistake: Uses 30° for each eighth

quiz.q: An arrow ends pointing left after a 1/2 turn. Where did it start?
quiz.explain: A half turn reverses the arrow, so it started pointing right.
steps: A half turn reverses the arrow.
Undo it with another half turn from left.
Opposite of left is right, so it started pointing right.
Answer: Right
quiz.mistake: Turns only a quarter back

teach.ask: Gappu's arrow points up after a 1/4 turn clockwise. Where was it pointing before? Please teach me!
teach.praise: Turning back a quarter anticlockwise from up gives left. It started pointing left!
teach.nudge: What should I do to undo a turn?

revise.summary: A turn can be named as a fraction of a full turn, like 1/8, 1/4, 3/8 or 1/2. To find where an arrow started, turn it back the same amount the other way.
focus: Name turns as fractions in eighths
Find where an arrow started
Change fractions of a turn to degrees
remember: To undo a turn, turn back the same amount the other way
traps: Don't turn back in the same direction.
Don't use 30° for each eighth; it is 45°.

learn.hook: Guess first, then measure! Your guess gets better every time you check.
points: Make a turn measurer: fold a paper circle into 8 equal parts and open it. Each crease is 1/8 turn.
Estimate the angle first, then place the measurer's centre on the corner and one crease on an arm.
Count the eighths to the other arm. 2 eighths = 1/4 turn (right), less is acute, 3 eighths is obtuse.
We can add turns: 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4 turn. 1/4 + 1/8 = 3/8 turn.
An equilateral triangle's corner is less than 1/8 + 1/8 turn, so it is acute.
Turns like 1/8 + 1/6 are easy in degrees: 1/8 turn = 45° and 1/6 turn = 60°, so together 105°, an obtuse angle.

example.q: Draw the turn 1/2 + 1/4. How much of a full turn is it?

learn.reallife: Skateboarders talk about a 'one-eighty' — a half turn! They add turns to describe tricks.

quiz.q: What fraction of a full turn is 1/2 + 1/4 turn?
steps: Make the bottoms the same: 1/2 = 2/4.
So the turn is 3/4 of a full turn.
Answer: 3/4
quiz.mistake: Adds tops and bottoms separately

quiz.q: What fraction of a full turn is 1/4 + 1/8 turn?
steps: Make the bottoms the same: 1/4 = 2/8.
So the turn is 3/8 of a full turn.
Answer: 3/8
quiz.mistake: Adds the bottoms

quiz.q: Sunil measures an angle with his turn measurer. It covers 3 of the 8 equal parts. What kind of angle is it?
quiz.explain: 3/8 is more than 2/8 (a quarter) but less than 4/8 (a half), so obtuse.
steps: 3 of 8 parts = 3/8 turn.
A quarter is 2/8 and a half is 4/8; 3/8 is between them.
More than a right angle, less than straight → obtuse.
Answer: Obtuse
quiz.mistake: Thinks 3 parts is small, so acute

quiz.q: An angle covers exactly 2 of the 8 parts. What is it?
quiz.explain: 2/8 = 1/4 turn, which is a right angle.
steps: 2 of 8 parts = 2/8 turn.
A 1/4 turn is a right angle.
Answer: A right angle, 1/4 turn
quiz.mistake: Does not simplify 2/8 to 1/4

quiz.q: Jaya guesses an angle is a 1/4 turn. She measures and finds it is 1/8 turn. What kind of angle is it really?
quiz.explain: 1/8 turn is less than a quarter turn, so acute.
steps: Trust the measurement, not the guess: it is 1/8 turn.
1/8 is less than 1/4 (2/8), so less than a right angle.
So the angle is acute.
Answer: Acute
quiz.mistake: Keeps the guess instead of the measurement

quiz.q: How many degrees is a 3/4 turn?
steps: Answer: 270°
quiz.mistake: Uses 100 as a full turn

quiz.q: Which is the best way to check your guess of an angle?
options: Count the corners of the shape
Look at the colour of the shape
Put the centre of the turn measurer on the corner and count the eighths
Measure the length of the arms
quiz.explain: Angle size is the amount of turn between the arms, not their length.
steps: Angle size is the amount of turn between the arms.
Corners, colour and arm length do not tell the turn.
So put the measurer's centre on the corner and count the eighths.
Answer: Put the centre of the turn measurer on the corner and count the eighths
quiz.mistake: Thinks longer arms mean a bigger angle

quiz.q: 1/2 + 1/8 turn is the same as how many eighths?
steps: Change 1/2 to eighths: 1/2 = 4/8.
Answer: 5/8
quiz.mistake: Adds bottoms together

quiz.q: Meera draws a turn of 1/8 and then 1/6 more. A 1/8 turn is 45° and a 1/6 turn is 60°. How big is the whole turn?
quiz.explain: 45° + 60° = 105°. That is more than a quarter turn (90°) and less than a half turn, so it is obtuse.
steps: Answer: 105°
quiz.mistake: Subtracts the two turns instead of adding them

teach.ask: Gappu made a paper turn measurer. How do I use it to measure the corner of a shape?
teach.praise: Centre on the corner, a crease on one arm, then count eighths. Easy!
teach.nudge: Where do I put the centre of the measurer?

revise.summary: A paper turn measurer has 8 equal parts. Estimate, then put its centre on the corner and count eighths; turns can also be added like fractions or in degrees.
focus: Measure an angle with a turn measurer
Add turns like 1/2 + 1/4
Name the angle from the number of eighths
remember: 2 eighths = 1/4 turn = right angle; fewer is acute; 3 eighths is obtuse
1/8 turn = 45°, 1/6 turn = 60°, together 105°
traps: Don't add the bottom numbers of turns.
Longer arms do not make a bigger angle.

topics.title: Angles on clocks and in shapes

learn.hook: Your wall clock is a giant angle machine. Every number is a hidden 30° jump!
points: A clock face has 12 equal gaps. 360° ÷ 12 = 30°, so each gap is 30°.
To find the angle between the hands at an o'clock time, count gaps and multiply by 30°.
In 5 minutes the minute hand moves one gap, which is 30°.
Letters and shapes have angles too: L has a right angle, V has an acute angle, a rectangle has 4 right angles.

example.q: What is the angle between the clock hands at 4 o'clock? What kind of angle is it?
steps: From 12 to 4 there are 4 gaps
120° is between 90° and 180°

learn.reallife: Clock hands, scissors, a ladder against a wall and the hands of a cricket umpire show angles every day.

items.q: Angle between the hands at 3 o'clock
Angle between the hands at 4 o'clock

games.title: Smallest to largest
games.prompt: Put these angles from smallest to largest

quiz.q: On a clock face, how many degrees is the turn from one number to the next?
quiz.explain: A full turn is 360° and there are 12 gaps. 360° ÷ 12 = 30°.
steps: Full turn = 360°
12 equal gaps
Answer: 30°
quiz.mistake: Divides by the wrong number or uses 12 as the angle

quiz.q: What is the angle between the clock hands at 2 o'clock?
quiz.explain: From 12 to 2 is 2 gaps: 2 × 30° = 60°.
steps: 2 gaps
Answer: 60°
quiz.mistake: Counts only one gap or multiplies by 10

quiz.q: What is the angle between the clock hands at 6 o'clock?
quiz.explain: From 12 to 6 is 6 gaps: 6 × 30° = 180°. The hands make a straight line.
steps: 6 gaps
Answer: 180°
quiz.mistake: Thinks the hands at 6 make a right angle

quiz.q: The minute hand turns clockwise from 12 to 9. How many degrees does it turn?
quiz.explain: 12 to 9 clockwise is 9 gaps: 9 × 30° = 270°, a three-quarter turn.
steps: 9 gaps clockwise
Answer: 270°
quiz.mistake: Measures the short way back (90°) instead of the clockwise turn

quiz.q: Which capital letter has a right angle?
quiz.explain: L has a straight up line meeting a flat line, making a square corner.
steps: A right angle is a square corner made by two straight lines.
O, S and C are curved letters with no corners.
L has a straight up line meeting a flat line, so L has a right angle.
Answer: L
quiz.mistake: Thinks curved letters have angles

quiz.q: How many right angles does a rectangle have?
quiz.explain: Every corner of a rectangle is a square corner, and it has 4 corners.
steps: Every corner of a rectangle is a square corner (right angle).
A rectangle has 4 corners.
So it has 4 right angles.
Answer: 4
quiz.mistake: Thinks only a square has right angles

quiz.q: In 20 minutes, through how many degrees does the minute hand turn?
quiz.explain: 20 minutes is 4 gaps of 5 minutes. 4 × 30° = 120°.
steps: 20 ÷ 5 = 4 gaps
Answer: 120°
quiz.mistake: Uses minutes as degrees

quiz.q: Joseph opens a book flat so the two covers make a straight line. What is the angle between them?
quiz.explain: A straight line is a half turn, which is 180°.
steps: The two covers make a straight line.
A straight line is a half turn.
A half turn = 360° ÷ 2 = 180°.
Answer: 180°
quiz.mistake: Thinks a flat open book is a right angle or a full turn

teach.ask: Gappu asks: 'How can a clock tell me about angles?'
teach.praise: Tick-tock! Each gap is 30 degrees, so I count gaps and multiply. Brilliant!
teach.nudge: How many degrees is one gap on the clock? How do I use the gaps?

revise.summary: A clock face has 12 equal gaps of 30° each. Count gaps between the hands and multiply by 30° to find the angle; letters and shapes have angles too.
focus: Find the angle between clock hands at o'clock times
Find the turn of the minute hand in some minutes
Spot right angles in letters and shapes
remember: 360° ÷ 12 = 30° for each gap
Angle = number of gaps × 30°
In 5 minutes the minute hand turns 30°
traps: Don't measure the short way back when the turn is clockwise: 12 to 9 clockwise is 270°.
Don't use minutes as degrees: 20 minutes is 120°.

learn.hook: The minute hand is at 12. Give it a quarter turn — where does it land? And which way does it turn?
points: The minute hand always turns clockwise: 12 → 1 → 2 → 3 …
A quarter turn of the minute hand moves it 15 minutes: from 12 to 3, or from 3 to 6.
A half turn moves it 30 minutes: from 12 to 6, or from 2 to 8.
Clockwise is the way clock hands move. Anticlockwise is the opposite way.
A quarter turn clockwise from facing up ends facing right; anticlockwise ends facing left.

example.q: The minute hand points to 4. It makes a quarter turn. Where does it point now?
steps: Quarter turn = 15 minutes = 3 numbers

learn.reallife: Screws tighten clockwise and loosen anticlockwise. Most taps open anticlockwise.

games.title: Where does the minute hand go?

items.text: At 12, a quarter turn moves it to ___
At 3, a half turn moves it to ___
At 6, a quarter turn moves it to ___
At 9, a three-quarter turn moves it to ___

games.title: Which way?
items: That is how the word got its name.
Facing up, a quarter turn clockwise makes you face left.
Clockwise from up goes to the right.
Anticlockwise is the opposite of clockwise.
A full turn clockwise and a full turn anticlockwise end in the same place.
Both bring you back to the start.

quiz.q: The minute hand points to 2. It makes a quarter turn. Where does it point now?
quiz.explain: A quarter turn is 15 minutes, which is 3 numbers. 2 + 3 = 5.
steps: 15 minutes = 3 numbers
Answer: 5
quiz.mistake: Moves only one number

quiz.q: The minute hand points to 1. It makes a half turn. Where does it point now?
quiz.explain: A half turn is 6 numbers. 1 + 6 = 7.
steps: Half turn = 6 numbers
Answer: 7
quiz.mistake: Always lands on 6 for a half turn

quiz.q: The minute hand points to 10. It makes a quarter turn. Where does it point now?
quiz.explain: 10 + 3 = 13, but the clock goes back to 1 after 12.
steps: A quarter turn = 15 minutes = 3 numbers on the clock.
From 10 count 3 numbers clockwise: 11, 12, 1.
After 12 the clock goes back to 1. It points to 1.
Answer: 1
quiz.mistake: Forgets the numbers go round after 12

quiz.q: The minute hand starts at 12 and makes a three-quarter turn. Where does it point?
quiz.explain: Three-quarter turn = 45 minutes = 9 numbers. It lands on 9.
steps: A three-quarter turn = 3 × 15 = 45 minutes.
45 minutes = 45 ÷ 5 = 9 numbers.
From 12, 9 numbers clockwise lands on 9.
Answer: 9
quiz.mistake: Turns anticlockwise

quiz.q: Which way do the hands of a clock turn?
quiz.explain: Clockwise is named after the way clock hands move.
steps: Clockwise is named after the way clock hands move.
Clock hands never move the other way.
So they turn clockwise.
Answer: Clockwise
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the names

quiz.q: A lizard faces up (north on the wall) and makes a quarter turn. Now it faces left. Which way did it turn?
quiz.explain: From up, turning to the left is opposite to clock hands, so anticlockwise.
steps: Clockwise from up goes to right; anticlockwise from up goes to left.
The lizard went from up to left.
So it turned anticlockwise.
Answer: Anticlockwise
quiz.mistake: Thinks every turn is clockwise

quiz.q: A ladybird faces right and makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does it face now?
quiz.explain: Clockwise goes up → right → down → left. From right, the next is down.
steps: Clockwise order: up → right → down → left.
The ladybird starts at right.
One quarter turn clockwise from right is down.
Answer: Down
quiz.mistake: Turns anticlockwise instead

quiz.q: A bird faces down and makes a quarter turn. Now it faces right. Which way did it turn?
quiz.explain: Clockwise from down would go to left. Going to right is anticlockwise.
steps: Clockwise order: up → right → down → left.
Clockwise from down would go to left.
Going from down to right is the other way: anticlockwise.
Answer: Anticlockwise
quiz.mistake: Does not follow the clock order

teach.ask: Gappu's minute hand points to 3. If it makes a half turn, where will it point, and which way does it move?
teach.praise: A half turn is 6 numbers clockwise, so from 3 it goes to 9!
teach.nudge: How many numbers does a half turn move the hand?

revise.summary: The minute hand always turns clockwise. A quarter turn moves it 15 minutes (3 numbers) and a half turn 30 minutes (6 numbers).
focus: Find where the minute hand points after a turn
Tell whether a turn was clockwise or anticlockwise
remember: Quarter turn = 15 minutes = 3 numbers
Half turn = 30 minutes = 6 numbers
Clockwise: up → right → down → left
traps: Don't forget the numbers go round after 12: 10 + 3 numbers lands on 1.
Don't always land on 6 for a half turn; from 1 it lands on 7.

learn.hook: Facing North, you make three right turns. Which way do you face? Your left hand might know the answer!
points: Clockwise order of directions: North → East → South → West → North.
A right turn is a quarter turn clockwise. A left turn is a quarter turn anticlockwise.
Count quarter turns: 2 quarter turns = half turn (face the opposite way), 4 quarter turns = back to the start.
Different turns can end the same way: 3 quarter turns clockwise = 1 quarter turn anticlockwise.
On a map, a half turn means facing the opposite direction: if you face the school (East), after a half turn you face West.

example.q: Priya faces East and makes 3 quarter turns anticlockwise. Which way does she face?
steps: Anticlockwise from East: North (1), West (2), South (3)

learn.reallife: Drivers follow 'turn right, then left' directions. Pilots and sailors use turns and directions too.

quiz.q: Ravi faces North and makes 2 quarter turns clockwise. Which way does he face?
quiz.explain: Two quarter turns make a half turn, so he faces the opposite way: South.
steps: 2 quarter turns = a half turn.
A half turn makes you face the opposite way.
Opposite of North is South.
Answer: South
quiz.mistake: Moves only one direction

quiz.q: Meena faces West and makes 1 quarter turn clockwise. Which way does she face?
quiz.explain: Clockwise order: West → North.
steps: Clockwise order: North → East → South → West → North.
From West, one quarter turn clockwise is the next one.
West → North. She faces North.
Answer: North
quiz.mistake: Goes anticlockwise

quiz.q: Ali faces South and makes 3 quarter turns clockwise. Which way does he face?
quiz.explain: Clockwise from South: West (1), North (2), East (3).
steps: Clockwise order: North → East → South → West → North.
From South count 3: West (1), North (2), East (3).
He faces East.
Answer: East
quiz.mistake: Counts in the wrong direction

quiz.q: Which turn makes you face the same way as 3 quarter turns clockwise?
quiz.explain: 3 quarter turns one way leave just 1 quarter turn to complete the circle, so it equals 1 quarter turn the other way.
steps: A full turn is 4 quarter turns.
3 quarter turns clockwise is 1 quarter turn short of a full turn.
So it ends the same as 1 quarter turn anticlockwise.
Answer: 1 quarter turn anticlockwise
quiz.mistake: Thinks only clockwise turns can match

quiz.q: Sara faces East. She turns right, then right again. Which way does she face?
quiz.explain: Each right turn is a quarter clockwise: East → South → West.
steps: A right turn is a quarter turn clockwise.
East → South (first right) → West (second right).
She faces West.
Answer: West
quiz.mistake: Turns left instead of right

quiz.q: Raj faces North. After some turns he faces East. Which could NOT be his turn?
quiz.explain: A half turn from North gives South, not East. The others end at East.
steps: Check each turn from North.
5 quarter clockwise = 1 quarter clockwise → East; 3 quarter anticlockwise → West, South, East.
A half turn gives South, not East. So the half turn could NOT be his turn.
Answer: A half turn
quiz.mistake: Thinks a half turn is a quarter turn

quiz.q: On a map, Asha faces the market, which is to her North. She makes a half turn. What is in front of her now?
quiz.explain: A half turn makes her face the opposite direction, South.
steps: A half turn makes her face the opposite direction.
She faced North, so now she faces South.
In front of her is whatever is to her South.
Answer: Whatever is to her South
quiz.mistake: Thinks a half turn is a quarter turn

quiz.q: Dev faces West. How many quarter turns anticlockwise make him face North?
quiz.explain: Anticlockwise from West: South (1), East (2), North (3).
steps: Anticlockwise order: North → West → South → East → North.
From West: South (1), East (2), North (3).
So 3 quarter turns anticlockwise.
Answer: 3
quiz.mistake: Counts clockwise

teach.ask: Gappu faces North and turns right two times. Which way am I facing? Help me!
teach.praise: First East, then South. Two right turns make a half turn!
teach.nudge: What is the clockwise order of the directions?

revise.summary: Directions go North → East → South → West clockwise. A right turn is a quarter turn clockwise and a left turn is a quarter turn anticlockwise; different turns can end the same way.
focus: Find the direction after quarter turns
Match turns that end the same way
Use half turns on a map
remember: Clockwise order: North → East → South → West → North
2 quarter turns = half turn (opposite way); 4 = back to start
3 quarter turns clockwise = 1 quarter turn anticlockwise
traps: Don't count in the wrong direction.
A half turn is not a quarter turn: from North it gives South.
